name: AnimeCon
blurb: The Netherlands' longest-running anime convention, held at De Broodfabriek in Rijswijk with cosplay, gaming and Japanese arcades.

editions.evidence: Homepage text: 'AnimeCon 2027 will take place from April 16th until April 18th, 2027!' with a live countdown reading 'AnimeCon 2027 will start on April 16th at 14:00 CEST ... And will end on April 18th at 20:00 CEST' (193 days from today, 2026-10-05, matching exactly).

notes: Corrected venue/city from the seed's 'Rotterdam' (Ahoy): the site's own Venue & Directions page names De Broodfabriek, Volmerlaan 12, Rijswijk as the 2027 venue. That same venue page's separate 'Opening Times' widget confusingly still reads 'Date: April 17 - 19' (stale, not updated); the homepage's live countdown/headline (April 16-18, 2027) was trusted instead since it matches exactly and is clearly the current authoritative value, per RESEARCH.md's rule to trust visible page text/countdowns over stale fragments. The Special Guests page has no guest cards yet (only nav/partner logos), so guests is 'none-yet'.
